### 1 — Scene
A cooked meal that appears to contain cauliflower, scrambled eggs, browned meat patties or cutlets, and roasted potato pieces. Strong sunlight makes the central food somewhat uncertain.

### 2 — Vessel
A shallow dinner plate, approximately **26 cm** across.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ **531 cm²**.

### 3–7 — Items, coverage, volume, weight and energy
The yellow mound is treated as scrambled eggs. No separate sauce or oil quantity is clearly distinguishable; cooking fat is included in the energy estimates.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

| Scrambled eggs | 24% | 127 cm² × 1.6 cm = 203 ml | 0.90 g/ml | 183 g | 160 | 293 kcal |
| Browned meat patties/cutlets | 18% | 96 cm² × 1.4 cm = 134 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 127 g | 250 | 318 kcal |
| Roasted potatoes | 14% | 74 cm² × 2.2 cm = 163 ml | 0.65 g/ml | 106 g | 150 | 159 kcal |

**Coverage check:** 26 + 24 + 18 + 14 = **82%**, consistent with the visible food coverage.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate totals **598 g and approximately 816 kcal**. Roughly 600 g is plausible for this substantially filled dinner plate. The largest uncertainty is the identity of the sunlit yellow food and the meat preparation.
